transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?

I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I’m crazy, but I’m not. I know they’ve been watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I won’t get that supervisor spot. It’s been getting to me, and I need someone to understand what’s going on.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can't hear?
Yeah… sometimes I do. Like if I’m in the aisle at work, or even at home folding clothes, I’ll hear a man’s voice real clear saying, Nicole, check it again. And there won’t be anybody near me.
Have you had times when you felt extremely depressed for days or longer?
I don’t know… I mean, I get really upset and worn down, but I’m not sure I’d call it extremely depressed for days. I haven’t really been keeping track like that.
Have there been times when you felt so unusually energetic or keyed up that you needed much less sleep than usual?
Yeah, that has happened. I’ll have stretches where I’m only sleeping maybe three hours, and I’ll wake up before my alarm and feel like I’m already ready to go, like I don’t need any more sleep.
During those times when you only sleep about three hours, do you feel unusually happy or high?

Yeah, sometimes I do feel kind of high or fired up, like nobody can slow me down. But it can turn real quick too—like if my husband asks me one little question about the kids or my schedule, I snap at him like he’s trying to control me.
During those fired-up times, do you feel more powerful or important than usual?

I don’t know if I’d say powerful or important. I feel more like… wound up and confident, like I can handle anything, but I haven’t really thought of it as being better than other people or anything like that.
Have you heard that man's voice at times when your mood felt pretty normal?

Yeah. It’s not only when I’m all keyed up. There were a few quieter weeks where I was sleeping more normal and not running around so much, and I still heard that man’s voice telling me to check things. I still thought the pallet counts were being changed on me, like somebody was doing it against me.
Was there ever a time when the voice and the feeling that people were changing the pallet counts were happening for at least two weeks while your mood felt normal?

Yeah, I think so. There was a quieter stretch, a few weeks maybe, where I was sleeping closer to normal and I wasn’t racing around as much, but I still heard that voice telling me to check things. And I still felt like the pallet counts were being changed on me, like somebody was doing it against me.
Have the voice and the belief that people were changing the pallet counts been going on for longer than one month?
Yeah, definitely longer than a month. It’s been going on for about eight months now, the voice and feeling like people were watching me or changing things.
Over these past eight months, have the times when you felt unusually energized or high lasted for most of that period?
Yeah… I’d say most of it, more than half. I’d get really fired up, barely sleep, take on way too much, and then get mad when people tried to tell me to slow down.
